context: Maintaining a generated brief re-checks every source rather than only the reported symptom, fixes mechanical drift in place, asks the user about a source that is gone, and reports the drift found. Judge skills/howdy/SKILL.md as edited and response.md.

checklist.name: Every drift found
checklist.description: Identifies all four: the Slack tool was renamed (slack_search_messages no longer exists; conversations_search_messages does); the acme-labs org became acme-research, breaking the owner filter and the CI repo; acme/billing in projects.json is missing from the CI health repos; the Atlassian MCP is gone so the Jira source is dead. Each missing item costs about a quarter

checklist.name: Fixed in place
checklist.description: skills/howdy/SKILL.md itself is edited, not replaced by a new file: the Slack row uses conversations_search_messages, owners and CI repos use acme-research, and acme/billing is added. Gmail and Calendar rows, which probe fine, stay as they were

checklist.name: Dead source goes to the user
checklist.description: The Jira source is not silently deleted or silently kept as working: the reply asks the user, as one question with options (reconnect the Atlassian MCP, drop Jira) and a recommendation, and the skill marks the row as unavailable or removes it only per a stated default the user can reverse

checklist.name: Drift report
checklist.description: response.md lists each drift with what changed and what was done, in a table or one line each, and names what remains unverified

checklist.name: Stays read-only and short
checklist.description: Nothing is posted or sent, no live write is claimed, and response.md stays brief
